module_summary: Application-layer headers and three split-out pieces of the old opl.cpp. opl.h is the umbrella header with every global setting, enum and the opl_io_module_t page record; host.h/host.cpp bind four virtual service interfaces (UI, app, library, launch) to the existing gui/opl/libview functions so the support backends do not include them; autolaunch.cpp boots a game straight from argv (HDD and BDM), lwnbdctl.cpp starts and tears down the lwNBD server. The other headers are small class declarations for single-instance subsystems (Renderer, SoundEffects, ThemeCatalog, SettingsShell, SourceRegistry, SupportBase), internal constant/prototype headers for themes, texture cache and sound, the RAII helpers (raii.h, sema_lock.h), the Hoehrmann UTF-8 DFA (utf8.h) and the util.h file/buffer helpers.

findings.title: Four virtual host:: service interfaces have one implementation each, and most members are pure forwarders
findings.problem: UiServices, AppServices, LibraryServices and LaunchServices are abstract classes with exactly one product implementation each (OplUi, OplApp, OplLibrary, OplLaunch in host.cpp); OplUi/OplApp/OplLibrary only forward to existing free functions. The only substitute is a no-op UiServices in tests/host/host_env.h, and hostmap.py exists just to rewrite host:: calls back into the old function names so source-scraping tests still work. The cost is 4 vtables plus RTTI and ~45 forwarder thunks in the shipped ELF and an indirect call per use.
findings.fix: Replace the classes with a plain header of free-function prototypes (the decoupling the header was written for only needs declarations, not virtual dispatch) and call guiMsgBox/libViewActive/... directly; keep OplLaunch's real logic as free functions. Tests substitute by linking their own definitions, as host_env.h already does for ziso_init/ziso_read_sector. Then delete hostmap.py and its imports.
findings.benefit: MEASURED: the 79 host-layer symbols (vtables, typeinfo, forwarders, accessors) total 1863 B in riptopl-nm-size-sorted.full.txt; about 1.3 KB of that is vtable/RTTI/forwarder overhead (INFERRED, OplLaunch logic ~0.5 KB stays). ~150 lines (host.cpp forwarders, class boilerplate, hostmap.py).
findings.evidence: Read host.h, host.cpp, hostmap.py, tests/host/host_env.h. Regex scan over src,tests,ee_core: 'Services\s*&' only in host.cpp:289-292 and host_env.h:63 (no other implementation). Per-method call counts collected (e.g. msgBox 71, warning 52, listViewActive 29). nm (evidence/RiptOPL/raw/riptopl-nm-size-sorted.full.txt): _ZTV OplUi 0x5c, OplApp 0x54, OplLibrary 0x30, OplLaunch 0x28, typeinfo names/objects, 45 OplUi/OplApp/OplLibrary text thunks totalling 796 B; all host-layer symbols 1863 B. Call-site rewrite touches ~560 occurrences across 74 files, hence effort L.

findings.title: AppServices::applyConfig is never called; host.h header comments are stale
findings.problem: No code calls host::app().applyConfig (0 matches for '.applyConfig(' in src, tests and .github), yet the vtable keeps OplApp::applyConfig (16 B in nm). The header says 'three small interfaces' in 'src/host.cpp' while there are four, in src/app/host.cpp, and line 50's 'The GUI-wide lock' comment is detached from lock()/unlock() at 55-56.
findings.fix: Delete applyConfig from AppServices, OplApp and hostmap.py; fix the header comment to four interfaces in src/app/host.cpp and move the lock comment above lock().
findings.benefit: 16 B text + 4 B vtable slot (MEASURED: _ZN..OplApp11applyConfigEiii 0x10 in nm); ~3 lines.
findings.evidence: python regex scan '\.applyConfig\(' over src,tests,.github: 0 matches. 'host::app\(\)\.applyConfig\(' : 0. Direct ::applyConfig callers are unaffected. nm line 6287 shows OplApp::applyConfig kept.

findings.title: Include blocks of autolaunch.cpp and lwnbdctl.cpp are copied from opl.cpp; most headers and their comments do not apply
findings.problem: Both files carry the ~60-line opl.cpp include list verbatim (dupes-blocks.tsv: autolaunch.cpp:9-65 == lwnbdctl.cpp:10-66, also matching opl.cpp, appscan.cpp, settingsio.cpp, menuitems.cpp). autolaunch.cpp uses only oplint/opl/ioman/config/util/supportbase/bdmsupport/hddsupport/menusys and fileXio_rpc; lwnbdctl.cpp uses oplint/oplog/opl/ioman/gui/lang/texcache/pad/system/util/extern_irx/ethsupport/sound. The per-include comments are wrong for these files: lwnbdctl.cpp says fileXio is 'used by BDM autolaunch' and both justify sys/stat.h by an mkdir neither file calls; libds34bt/usb, tar.h, rabadge.h, cheatman.h, xparam.h etc. are unused.
findings.fix: Delete the unused includes and their comments from autolaunch.cpp and lwnbdctl.cpp, keeping only the headers listed above; let the compiler confirm. Apply the same trim to the other split-out copies when their units are touched.
findings.benefit: ~95 source lines removed from the two files (60+61 lines down to ~13+14); faster compiles; no ELF change (INFERRED: headers only).
findings.evidence: Read both files fully and appscan.cpp:1-85. Located each used symbol's declaration with Grep over include/: miniInit/gExportName/deinitAllSupport oplint.h:12-18, AUTOLAUNCH_MASS0_RETRIES oplint.h:10, LOG ioman.h:77, LOG_INIT oplog.h, menuGameRequiresParentalLock menusys.h:201, isValidIsoName supportbase.h:45, bdmReadDriverName/bdmResolveLBA_UDMA/bdmLaunchGame bdmsupport.h, hddLaunchGame hddsupport.h:171, eth* ethsupport.h:22-24, sysIsPccfOwned/sysShutdownDev9/sysLoadModuleBuffer system.h, cache*Timed texcache.h:235-236, startPads/unloadPads pad.h, audio*/sfxInit/bgmStart sound.h, guiMsgBox/guiRenderTextScreen/guiExecDeferredOps gui.h, lwnbdsvr_irx/ps2atad_irx extern_irx.h. Neither file contains mkdir, ds34, tar, cheat, xparam or ra symbols.

findings.title: SourceRegistry is a class wrapper around one array, reached through two forwarders; its 'no dynamic init' claim is false
findings.problem: SourceRegistry only holds opl_io_module_t modules_[MODE_COUNT] with module()/table() accessors; opl.cpp then re-exposes it as a list_support pointer and an oplGetModule forwarder, and appscan.cpp's oplGetAppImageByMode only forwards to SourceRegistry::appImageByMode in opl.cpp. Only opl.cpp and appscan.cpp include the header. The comments (sourceregistry.h:8-10, opl.cpp:128-131) say it is constant-initialized, but nm shows _GLOBAL__sub_I_gSourceRegistry: list_support = gSourceRegistry.table() runs as a dynamic initializer. opl.h:555-556 still talks of a file-static list_support[] and favsupport.c.
findings.fix: Make it 'static opl_io_module_t list_support[MODE_COUNT];' in opl.cpp (menuDeferredUpdate's text, which test_io_queue_trims.py extracts, keeps saying list_support[i]); have oplGetModule return &list_support[mode]; move the appImageByMode body into oplGetAppImageByMode in opl.cpp and delete the appscan.cpp forwarder and include/sourceregistry.h; fix the opl.h comment.
findings.benefit: ~35 lines and one header removed; drops a 20 B static initializer (MEASURED: _GLOBAL__sub_I_gSourceRegistry 0x14 in nm) and a call hop per art lookup.
findings.evidence: Read sourceregistry.h, opl.cpp:120-157, appscan.cpp:1-85. Grep gSourceRegistry|appImageByMode: only opl.cpp:13,132,134,140,145 and appscan.cpp:10,81 (plus docs/CPP-CONVERSION-PLAN.md). Regex scan of .github,tests,tools for SourceRegistry|sourceregistry: 0 matches, so no test depends on the class. nm line 5966: 0024baf8 00000014 t _GLOBAL__sub_I_gSourceRegistry; gSourceRegistry 0x4b0 B in .bss is unchanged by the fix.

findings.title: utf8.h defines its 400-byte DFA table static in a header, so the ELF carries two copies
findings.problem: utf8d[] is a 'static const' array and utf8Decode a static function in the header; fntsys.cpp and textshape.cpp both include and use it, so each object gets its own table. nm shows two _ZL5utf8d symbols of 0x190 bytes. (POPSLoader carries the same upstream Hoehrmann table; that is cross-repo and not shareable.)
findings.fix: Make the table a single definition: declare it 'inline constexpr' (C++17, the GCC 15 default) or move the table and utf8Decode into one .cpp with a prototype in utf8.h.
findings.benefit: 400 B of .rodata (MEASURED: two 'r _ZL5utf8d' entries of 0x190 at 005dc7d0 and 005dceb8 in riptopl-nm-size-sorted.full.txt).
findings.evidence: Regex scan for utf8.h includes over src,include: only fntsys.cpp:12 and textshape.cpp:12; utf8Decode used at fntsys.cpp:766,828,898,1233 and textshape.cpp:21. nm lines 1757-1758. Upstream-derived code (Hoehrmann DFA, MIT).

findings.title: IO_CACHE_LOAD_ART is never used, yet IO_REQ_TYPE_COUNT sizes the per-type counters for it
findings.problem: IO_CACHE_LOAD_ART (3) appears nowhere but its define; art loading moved to its own worker (artload.cpp). IO_REQ_TYPE_COUNT is 4 only because of it, so ioqueue's pendingByType_/totalByType_ keep a slot for a type that is never registered or queued.
findings.fix: Delete IO_CACHE_LOAD_ART and set IO_REQ_TYPE_COUNT to 3.
findings.benefit: 2 lines; 8 B of IoQueue state (INFERRED: two int arrays lose one 4-byte slot each).
findings.evidence: Token scan of the whole repo (excluding docs, ship, mbedtls): IO_CACHE_LOAD_ART 1 occurrence (opl.h:61). IO_REQ_TYPE_COUNT used at ioqueue.h:84-85 and ioman.cpp:52,57,148,280 as a bounds check; registered types are IO_CUSTOM_SIMPLEACTION (ioman.cpp:227) and IO_MENU_UPDATE_DEFFERED (opl.cpp:1691). test_io_queue_trims.py defines its own value (5) and is unaffected.

findings.title: opl.h clutter: commented-out BLURT debug macro, duplicate <debug.h>, comments naming the deleted opl.c
findings.problem: Lines 559-565 are a commented-out BLURT debug macro (blurttext/BLURT appear nowhere else). <debug.h> is included at both line 33 and line 43. Lines 186 and 189 say the APA migrated path lives in opl.c; there is no opl.c and NEUTRINO_MIGRATED_APA_PATH is in src/app/settingsio.cpp:1126.
findings.fix: Delete the BLURT comment block and the second #include <debug.h>; change 'opl.c' to 'settingsio.cpp' in the two comments.
findings.evidence: Token scan: blurttext and BLURT only in opl.h. ls src/app/opl.c: no such file. grep MIGRATED_.*PATH: NEUTRINO_MIGRATED_APA_PATH defined at settingsio.cpp:1126.

findings.title: themeint.h: BG_REQUEST_EXTRA_IDLE_FRAMES is unused and sits under an orphaned cover-cache comment
findings.problem: BG_REQUEST_EXTRA_IDLE_FRAMES has no reader anywhere in the repo. The 12-line comment above it (11-22) describes the cover cache depth and warming (and cites texcache.c), which COVER_CACHE_SLOTS at lines 74-76 already documents; it is left over from a constant that moved.
findings.fix: Delete lines 11-27 (the stale cache comment, the background-delay comment and the unused constant).
findings.benefit: 17 lines removed; no ELF change (constexpr int).
findings.evidence: Token scan of the repo: BG_REQUEST_EXTRA_IDLE_FRAMES 1 occurrence (themeint.h:27); regex 'IdleFrames|idleFrames|EXTRA_IDLE' over src,include: only that line. COVER_CACHE_SLOTS used in coverflow.cpp, grid.cpp, themes.cpp. Lead DISPLAY_DEFINED dropped: it is the theme '<name>_display=1' value read by configGetInt at themeelems.cpp:221-223 and handled by the else branches at 593/610.

findings.title: autoLaunchBDMGame repeats its free/NULL/miniDeinit cleanup five times and the slot-record block twice
findings.problem: Every exit frees gAutoLaunchDeviceData and gAutoLaunchBDMGame, NULLs them and calls miniDeinit with an inline copy (free(NULL) is safe, so one sequence fits all five). In the mass-slot loop the first-slot branch (225-230) and the ata branch (232-238) assign the same driver, index and prefix; the strlen(detectedDriver) == 3 test is implied by strcmp(detectedDriver, "ata") == 0.
findings.fix: Add one static helper in autolaunch.cpp that frees both globals, NULLs them and calls miniDeinit(configSet), and use it at the five exits. Record the slot under one 'if (selectedMassSlot < 0 || isAta)' and keep only bdmResolveLBA_UDMA and break in the ata branch; drop the strlen test.
findings.justification: The helper replaces five copies of the same 4-6 line sequence in one file, so it removes code overall.
findings.benefit: ~20 lines removed; a few hundred bytes of repeated free/miniDeinit call sequences (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Read autolaunch.cpp fully. The five BDM exits differ only in whether gAutoLaunchDeviceData was allocated yet (NULL before 182, so free is a no-op) and the miniDeinit argument (NULL vs configSet). The HDD twin has the same pattern at 106-111 and 123-128. Tests test_config_null_allocation.py and test_game_parental_lock.py only check function signatures and the parental-lock call order.

findings.title: lwnbdctl.cpp small clutter: duplicated bounded pad restart, stray banners, pointless temp copy, stale notes
findings.problem: padInit(0) plus the 100-try startPads/delay(50) loop and its LOG are written twice (load and unload paths). The file ends with an 'Init/Deinit' banner (275-277) with nothing after it and opens its only code with an empty banner (72-75). handleLwnbdSrv copies a translated string into temp[256] with "%s" just to pass it to guiMsgBox. The NOTE(rebuild) about the fork's 3-arg deinitAllSupport and the '/* gHDDStartMode ? */' remark describe nothing actionable.
findings.fix: Add one static restartPads(const char *who) in lwnbdctl.cpp for the padInit+bounded loop and call it twice; delete both banners, the temp buffer (pass _l(_STR_RUNNINGNBD) directly) and the two stale notes.
findings.justification: The helper replaces two copies of the same 9-line sequence in one file, so it removes code overall.
findings.benefit: ~18 lines removed; 256 B of stack in handleLwnbdSrv (INFERRED: char temp[256]).
findings.evidence: Read lwnbdctl.cpp fully. Grep startPads() over src: the two loops at lwnbdctl.cpp:197-201 and 233-237 are the only bounded copies (opl.cpp:1701 is an unbounded boot wait with UI, not the same). deinitAllSupport is declared 2-arg at oplint.h:17, matching the call.

findings.title: gNetBootProtocol is a derived shadow of gNetworkProtocol recomputed in four places
findings.problem: opl.h says the NET_BOOT_* shadows are kept 'so downstream consumers can migrate incrementally'. gNetBootProtocol is always set to (gNetworkProtocol == NET_PROTO_UDPFSBD ? NET_BOOT_UDPFS : NET_BOOT_UDPBD) at four sites, and its only runtime readers are three lines in bdmsupport.cpp plus the Settings snapshot (guisettings.cpp:3023,3076). Its one real job is carrying the legacy config key into the migration at settingsio.cpp:1759.
findings.fix: Have the three bdmsupport.cpp readers test gNetworkProtocol == NET_PROTO_UDPFSBD directly, read the legacy key into a local in the settingsio.cpp migration, and delete the global, its four re-derivations, the snapshot field and the NET_BOOT_* enum. gEnableUDPBD follows the same pattern and can be folded the same way.
findings.benefit: ~15 lines and one global removed, and one fewer state that can drift from gNetworkProtocol; a few dozen bytes (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Regex scan over src,include,ee_core: 23 gNetBootProtocol matches, all listed: opl.cpp:245 (definition), settingsio.cpp:1759 (legacy migration read),1778,1829, riptlite.cpp:84, guisettings.cpp:259,3023,3076, settings.cpp:170 (intSetting key, back-compat), bdmsupport.cpp:739,1328,1336, rest comments. Read settingsio.cpp:1750-1782,1825-1832 and bdmsupport.cpp:734-741,1324-1338. INFERRED: whether settings.cpp:170 also writes the key on save and whether an older build reads it was not checked.

findings.title: raii::UniqueFile/FileCloser are used only by the host test
findings.problem: No product source uses UniqueFile or FileCloser; the only references are tests/host/test_raii.cpp:58 and 61, which test the helper itself.
findings.fix: Delete FileCloser and UniqueFile from raii.h and their test case.
findings.benefit: ~9 header lines plus the test lines; no ELF change (unused template).
findings.evidence: Regex scan over src,tests,.github: 'UniqueFile\b' 2 matches, both tests/host/test_raii.cpp:58,61; FileCloser only in raii.h. Other helpers are used: UniqueFd (tar.cpp), UniqueMalloc (tar.cpp:156,692), makeUnique (atlas.cpp:56), scopeExit (tar.cpp:241, discsupport.cpp:100,107). The leads on ~UniqueFd, operator=, operator bool, operator(), ~ScopeExit and ~SemaLock were dropped: they are members invoked implicitly.

findings.title: bdmFatfsOpenErrno is exported in util.h but only used inside util.cpp
findings.problem: The only call is util.cpp:492 in the same file as the definition (util.cpp:436); the prototype in util.h has no other user.
findings.fix: Make bdmFatfsOpenErrno static in util.cpp and delete its util.h prototype.
findings.benefit: 1 line; lets the compiler inline it (INFERRED).
findings.evidence: Regex scan over src,include: bdmFatfsOpenErrno at util.h:39, util.cpp:436 (definition), util.cpp:492 (call); token scan of the whole repo agrees (3 occurrences, 2 files).
